mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases simultaneously, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 4.0% year-over-year), a decline in residential investment (RSAFS) signals weakening housing demand that foreshadows economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 4.0% and RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior quarter indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO increases over the prior quarter, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1250 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST < 1250 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals successful monetary policy that reduces inflation without triggering recession, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls simultaneously, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals unexpected labor market weakness that raises recession fears, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
